facts.fact: The energy regulator CRSE reports Senelec's SAIFI at 9.12 interruptions per customer per year in 2024 (9.12/12 = 0.76 a month), against a norm of 15.
The energy regulator CRSE reports Senelec's SAIFI at 8.4 interruptions per customer per year in 2023 (8.4/12 = 0.70 a month).
